items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. What's his name? What's your Uncle's name? Casson.

ctx.x: Leo, do you remember that? Yeah, he plays, yeah. He played guitar. Yeah, he still plays. I put him in the union, too. Yeah? I had my man on Uncle St. Charles. He played around the carnival with the guitar. Yeah? Who is it? Uncle Leo, yeah. Well, I swear. Joe was your Uncle too. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, my Uncle wrote the words, that name. Angry?
Yeah. What's his name? What's your Uncle's name? Casson.

Oh, the same Uncle? Yeah. Angry, yeah. You get that, yeah? Because we're the boys from the old England. Yeah, that's right. They said they stole that song. They said they stole that song. They said they stole that song.
